source: Priest Orteb: Wide paths of clay – not enough. Great plaza of clay – not enough. Walls of clay – not enough. My people, if all of world is clay, is this enough? To Hrokk, it is never enough.
target: 祭司奥特布：宽阔的泥路——不够。巨大的泥广场——不够。泥墙——不够。族人们，若全世界都是泥，这样够了吗？对赫洛克来说，永远不够。

source: Tribe: Orteb! Hrokk! Orteb! Hrokk! Hrokk! Orteb! ORTEB! HROKK! ORTEB! ORTEB! ORTEB! ORTEB! ORTEB…
target: 族人：奥特布！赫洛克！奥特布！赫洛克！赫洛克！奥特布！奥特布！赫洛克！奥特布！奥特布！奥特布！奥特布！奥特布……

source: Hrokk: The people coming from the south – do you see them too? They come for the bison and the elk, and they fight for the land to hunt them. Soon they will know of our village. Will you lead us with a spear and thrust it into an attacker?
target: 赫洛克：南方来的人——你也看见了吗？他们为野牛、马鹿而来，为猎地交战。很快，他们就会知道我们的村子。你会拿起长矛带领我们，把矛刺进敌人身上吗？

source: Hrokk: Clay is protection. What does the priest know of protection? He does not hunt, he does not fight. He does not know what danger to search for on the horizon.
target: 赫洛克：泥土能保护我们。祭司懂什么保护？他不打猎，不打仗。他不知道地平线上该提防什么危险。

source: Hrokk: Rah! This is the way of the Great Betrayer! The southern men know fear and greed! They will see our fields, our homes and strike with great violence like the mountain cat!
target: 赫洛克：呸！这是大背叛者的路！南方人懂恐惧，也懂贪婪！他们会看见我们的田地、家园，像山猫一样凶猛袭来！

source: Priest Orteb: The storykeepers tell us how we were attackers too. We killed for this land, for the cave of the black rock. We lost fathers and sons because we thought bloodshed was the way of life. But now, we know another way. These necklaces opened our hearts. They can open other hearts that—
target: 祭司奥特布：守故事的人告诉我们，我们也曾是入侵者。我们为了这片土地、为了黑岩洞穴而杀人。我们失去父亲与儿子，因为以为流血就是生存之道。可是现在，我们知道另一条路。这些项链打开了我们的心。也能打开其他人的心——

source: Hrokk: We have said enough – voice vote. I call the voice vote for the tribe chief. My people, name your leader.
target: 赫洛克：说够了——喊声表决。我要求以喊声选出部落首领。族人们，喊出你们领袖的名字。

source: Priest Orteb: Hrokk was strong, we know this. Hrokk was brave. He felled the Great Sloth as one man. But he sags like the elders. His strength is less. A strength that served us well. Now, the tribe needs two good eyes. Hrokk has eyes the color of clay. My eyes the color of water, meat, fish, grains, clouds, moon, and stars. My eyes see the dancing spirits in the fire’s smoke and ancestors walking in the morning fog. My eyes—
target: 祭司奥特布：赫洛克曾经强壮，我们都知道。赫洛克曾经勇敢。他独自击倒巨树懒。可他像长者一样衰弱了。力气少了。那份力气，曾好好守护我们。如今，部落需要两只好眼睛。赫洛克的眼睛只有泥土的颜色。我的眼睛有水、肉、鱼、谷物、云、月亮与星星的颜色。我的眼睛看见火烟中跳舞的灵，看见晨雾里行走的祖先。我的眼睛——

source: Quentinite Savyna: People of Obark, I honor you. Warriors of Obark, I salute you. My name is Quentinite Savyna, daughter of Nav’ed, who founded the Quentinite knowledge keepers. Your leader Rekter is dead. His war party is dead. No more need to die. SILENCE! I SPEAK! I traveled to the North where lakes are as large as the sky. I traveled to the West where peaks of mountains mingle with stars. I traveled to the South where elegant beasts are tamed and herded. I traveled to the East where the Ocean shapes the earth. I return after 40 years from a journey of great strife and great learning. Joining me are scholars, botanists, craftsmen, and scribes. Protecting us are nine warriors bound to my cause – expert swordsman from the Order of DOTCOM, which ended a legendary code that unlocked the world’s knowledge to any man. Each one of them is worth four seasoned warriors. I am also a proud mother. This is my son of 3 years, Ebned, and my daughter of 4 years, Ranavi. And this is my new friend Sadie Sloan. As of this moment, Obark and its suffering is no more. In its place will rise the city of Quent, serving the world as the greatest font of knowledge and progress. We will furnish you with supplies and you may leave peacefully if this is not your path. If you stay, you will work towards the growth of not just the men and women next to you, but of all of mankind. This is the purpose of Quent. LET US BUILD!
target: 昆汀修士莎维娜：欧巴克的人民，我向你们致敬。欧巴克的战士，我向你们敬礼。 我是昆汀修士莎维娜，纳维德之女。我的父亲创立了守护知识的昆汀修士。 你们的领袖雷克特死了。他的战团也死了。不必再有人死去。 安静！听我说！ 我去过北方，那里的湖泊像天空一样广阔。我去过西方，那里的山峰与星辰交会。我去过南方，那里的人驯养、放牧优美的兽群。我去过东方，那里的海洋塑造大地。 历经四十年的艰险与求知之旅，我回来了。同行的有学者、植物学家、工匠与抄写员。保护我们的，是九位献身于我志业的战士——来自 DOTCOM 修会的剑术高手。这个修会破解了传说中的密码，让任何人都能取得世界的知识。他们每一位，都抵得上四名老练战士。 我也是一位骄傲的母亲。这是我三岁的儿子艾布内德，和四岁的女儿拉娜维。这位是我的新朋友，莎蒂・斯隆。 从这一刻起，欧巴克及其苦难不复存在。取而代之的，将是昆特城，为世界提供最丰富的知识与进步之源。我们会提供物资；若这不是你们想走的路，可以平安离去。 若你们留下，所努力促进的成长，不只是身边男女的成长，而是全人类的成长。这就是昆特的使命。 让我们开始建设！

source:
her presence in the great stacks of the Rotunda Libraria, I hear of her works in the Royal Laboratoria, and I hear of her signing new laws approved by District Councilmembers – so she does exist. But ask me where, exactly, and I’ll gesture broadly to the ether. 

  I recall the shock of the announcement four years ago when Sadie the Beloved, before her passing, announced her heir. A young, brusque scholar of Exomnus. An orphan turned into the brightest mind of her class. Now the preeminent authority in various fields of theoretical physics. Incredible intellectual achievements to be sure, but allow me to count her achievements in governing: 0. 

Well, perhaps there is one achievement. I have never witnessed a greater divide in societal attitude between the Exomnus educated and the rest of us. Ever worsened, I would say, from Queen Yira’s continued obsession with research. Her posture is off. She overvalues the pursuit of
target:
她现身于圆厅图书馆的浩瀚书库，听说她在皇家实验室的研究，也听说她签署区议员通过的新法——所以，她确实存在。但若问我，她到底在哪里，我只能朝空气笼统一指。

我还记得四年前，深受爱戴的莎蒂在临终前宣布继承人时，众人的震惊。一位年轻而生硬的艾克索姆学者。从孤儿成为同侪中最聪明的人。如今，更是理论物理各领域的首要权威。学术成就无疑令人惊叹，但容我数一数她在治理上的成就：零。

嗯，或许还是有一项。我从未见过，受过艾克索姆教育的人与其余民众之间，社会态度的分歧如此之大。依我看，伊拉女王持续沉迷研究，让这道裂痕愈来愈深。她的立场偏了。她过度看重追求

knowledge in a society that thrives from its diversity in skills, traditions, celebrations, and artistic expression. 

On behalf of your people, Dear Queen, might I suggest you divert your attention from the study of gravity and, instead, focus on the gravity of our situation. We do not ask for the world. You-Are-Me Day is next week. Showing you are not invisible would be a fine start.

亲爱的女王，我谨代表您的人民，建议您暂且别研究重力，转而关注我们处境的沉重。我们要求的不多。下周就是你即是我日。让大家看见，您并非隐形人，就会是个不错的开始。

source: Press of Quent Your time well spent Marcelo 11, Year 105 After Founding Public Viewing of Temporal Cathedral Soon to End Quentizens are reminded that the newly built Temporal Cathedral in the Great Pine Woods will be closed to public viewing starting Apreen 1. The structure, part library and part laboratory, is devoted to studying the interrelationship of time, gravity, and space. Particular attention will be given to the exploration of what ancient philosophers called “dark energy” – a hypothetical “anti-gravity” force. The goal is to reveal natural truths hidden in the Fourth Dimension, otherwise known as the flow of Time. Those who visit will have the opportunity to meet Head of Temporal Research Pitra-Patra, the first-ever artificial intelligence being to be bestowed such notable leadership. “Unprecedented discoveries and advancements require the management of unprecedented amounts of information,” said Queen Yira, the driving force behind the Cathedral’s construction and intention. “Pitra-Patra is a gift from Moharan Praetis, a student of Temporal Studies at Exomnus Academy, and the invention of her father Vyndor Praetis, who we know as the leading authority in high-performance computing. I and fellow researchers are very pleased with Pitra-Patra’s depth of guidance and insight.” Protestors outside the Cathedral criticize its purpose and need. “Forget the 4th!” stated a concerned citizen who wished to remain anonymous. “We are beings of the 3rd dimension, so why must we meddle with forces beyond our perception? Besides, any child who has uploaded a basic human history cartridge knows that the hubris of mankind leads to its downfall. It’s not hard: forget the 4th!”
target: 昆特报 值得您花时间 建城后105年 Marcelo 11日 时间大教堂即将结束公众参观 提醒昆特市民，大松林中新建的时间大教堂，将自 Apreen 1 起停止开放公众参观。这座兼具图书馆与实验室功能的建筑，致力研究时间、重力与空间的相互关系。研究将特别着重于古代哲学家所称的「暗能量」——一种假设的「反重力」力量。目标是揭开隐藏于第四维度，亦即时间流动之中的自然真理。 参观者将有机会见到时间研究主管皮特拉・帕特拉，她是史上第一位获授如此重要领导职务的人工智慧个体。 推动大教堂兴建与研究方向的伊拉女王表示：「前所未有的发现与进展，需要管理前所未有的大量资讯。皮特拉・帕特拉是艾克索姆学院时间研究学生莫哈兰・普雷蒂斯送来的礼物，由她父亲温多尔・普雷蒂斯发明；我们都知道，他是高效能运算的顶尖权威。我和研究同僚都非常欣赏皮特拉・帕特拉深刻的指引与洞察。」 大教堂外的抗议者，则批评其宗旨与必要性。一位不愿具名的忧心市民表示：「忘掉第四维！我们是第三维度的生物，为什么非要干涉超出感知范围的力量？再说，任何上传过基础人类史卡匣的孩子都知道，人类的傲慢会导致自身衰败。这很简单：忘掉第四维！」

source: Press of Quent Your time well spent Embset 17, Year 127 After Founding Great Nav’ed Severed in Savyna’s Tomb Garden – Cult Activity Suspected Peace officers and investigators were alerted in the early morning to Great Nav’ed, the oldest tree within Quent, leaning against a neighboring apartment structure. The mighty Mesquite was severed near the bottom of its trunk. A note was taped to the tree’s plaque written in common language: “Life Must Fade. Cease the Portal. Forget the 4th.” Neighbors are highly concerned by the crime, but are also suspicious of the cryptic meaning of the text. “We believe the criminal suspects are members of the Forgetters Cult,” said Central District Lead Investigator Pellik Wren. “Cult tenets, essentially, oppose all interference with the temporal dimension, and we believe the note is consistent with that line of thinking. We are looking into the bizarre reference to a portal.” Artificial intelligence security footage revealed three hooded, masked figures pulling up on silent, hovering Magnetrik(R) scooters. Their baggy body coverings make it difficult to identify their builds using AI precision, and, at this time, no prints or other identifying traces of the crime have been found. “The march of progress does not yield to intimidation,” said Moharan Praetis, the institutional representative for the Temporal Cathedral. “Our research will continue to gather unprecedented data about dimensional associations, furthering our understanding of the nature of existence.” Praetis declined to comment on the “portal” mentioned in the criminal note. Quentizens are encouraged to contact Central District Peace Offices with any information that may lead to the detainment of the suspects.
target: 昆特报 值得您花时间 建城后127年 Embset 17日 莎维娜墓园「伟大的纳维德」遭砍断，疑涉教派活动 今晨，治安人员与调查员接获通报，昆特最古老的树「伟大的纳维德」，倒靠在邻近公寓建筑上。这棵雄伟的牧豆树，在树干底部附近遭到砍断。树木名牌上贴着一张以通用语书写的字条：「生命必须消逝。关闭传送门。忘掉第四维。」邻近居民对这起犯罪深感忧虑，也对字条隐晦的含义感到疑惑。 中央区首席调查员佩利克・雷恩表示：「我们认为，嫌犯是遗忘者教派的成员。其教义基本上反对一切对时间维度的干涉，我们认为字条符合这种思想。我们正在调查其中对传送门的古怪提及。」 人工智慧监控影像显示，三名戴兜帽、蒙面的身影，骑乘无声悬浮的 Magnetrik(R) 机车抵达。他们身穿宽松罩袍，即使用人工智慧的精准辨识，也难以确认体型。目前，现场尚未发现指纹或其他可供辨识的犯案痕迹。 时间大教堂机构代表莫哈兰・普雷蒂斯表示：「进步的脚步，不会向恐吓低头。我们的研究将继续搜集前所未有的维度关联数据，增进对存在本质的理解。」对于犯案字条提到的「传送门」，普雷蒂斯拒绝置评。 鼓励昆特市民，如有任何可能协助逮捕嫌犯的消息，请联络中央区治安办公室。
